scope: All 217 available Arabic adaptation units and all 16 English Umrah units. No complete English Al-Mukhtar or Wird edition exists.
method: Compare every current checksum-verified native unit with same-page PDF transcription candidates where a page mapping exists. Normalization and ordered word overlap locate differences; they do not establish fidelity, correct vowel marks or independent approval. Umrah's 16 adaptation units do not map one-to-one to its 138-page original. English remains bound to that adaptation, not established as original-faithful.
